metadata.question: Was vegetation greenness (NDVI) within a 40 km raidus around Moroto, Uganda during August 2023 lower than its average for August between 1991 and 2010?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: - Collection: MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1) for long-term comparison (1991-2010 vs 2023) - Date: August 1991-2010 (baseline) vs August 2023 (target) - Location: 40km radius around Moroto, Uganda (coordinates: 2.5333°N, 34.6667°E) 2. Masking Strategy: - MODIS NDVI has built-in quality flags, so I'll use the 'DetailedQA' band to mask poor quality pixels - Focus on reliable vegetation pixels only 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDVI for August 2023 - Calculate mean NDVI for August 1991-2010 baseline - Compare if 2023 is lower than baseline - Handle cases where collections are empty or no valid pixels Note: MODIS data starts from 2000, so I'll adjust the baseline to 2000-2010 instead of 1991-2010 to match available data. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const moroto = ee.Geometry.Point([34.6667, 2.5333]); const region = moroto.buffer(40000); // 40km radius // Time periods const baselineStart = '2000-08-01'; const baselineEnd = '2010-08-31'; const targetStart = '2023-08-01'; const targetEnd = '2023-08-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS NDVI const modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') .select(['NDVI', 'DetailedQA']); // Filter collections const baselineCol = modisCol .filterDate(baselineStart, baselineEnd) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')); const targetCol = modisCol .filterDate(targetStart, targetEnd); // Check collection sizes const baselineSize = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); const targetSize = targetCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline Images (2000-2010 August): ${baselineSize}`); console.log(`Target Images (2023 August): ${targetSize}`); if (baselineSize === 0 || targetSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Mask poor quality pixels function maskPoorQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('DetailedQA'); // MODIS QA bits: keep only best quality (bits 0-1 = 00) const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); return image.updateMask(mask); } const baselineMasked = baselineCol.map(maskPoorQuality); const targetMasked = targetCol.map(maskPoorQuality); // 4. Calculate mean NDVI values const baselineMean = baselineMasked.mean().select('NDVI'); const targetMean = targetMasked.mean().select('NDVI'); // Check valid pixels const baselineCount = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const targetCount = targetMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline valid pixels: ${baselineCount}`); console.log(`Target valid pixels: ${targetCount}`); if (baselineCount === 0 || targetCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI values const baselineNDVI = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const targetNDVI = targetMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline NDVI (2000-2010): ${baselineNDVI ? baselineNDVI.toFixed(4) : 'None'}`); console.log(`Target NDVI (2023): ${targetNDVI ? targetNDVI.toFixed(4) : 'None'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (baselineNDVI === null || targetNDVI === null || isNaN(baselineNDVI) || isNaN(targetNDVI) || baselineNDVI > 1 || targetNDVI > 1 || // NDVI range check baselineNDVI < -1 || targetNDVI < -1) { console.log("C3"); } else if (targetNDVI < baselineNDVI) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
